risks.title: Cyberattacks and IT Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions the growing risk of cyberattacks, ransomware and other security threats, acknowledging that its preventive measures may be insufficient and that incidents could negatively impact sales and profits

risks.title: Operational Disruptions from IT Failures
risks.score_rationale: The company recognizes the risk of operational disruptions due to software or hardware failures, including cyberattacks, with potential impact on operations and financial results

risks.title: Competition in the Consumer Products Industry
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive environment within the confectionery and food products industry, but benefits from a strong position and recognized brands

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a complex regulatory environment for food products but appears to have a good understanding of requirements and appropriate compliance measures

risks.title: Volatility in Raw Material Prices
risks.score_rationale: The company faces inflationary pressures on critical raw material costs, particularly cocoa and chocolate, which remain historically high despite recent declines. These fluctuations directly impact gross margins
